sec-head.p: Multimodal AI combines text, images, and audio, while unimodal models process only one data type.
Each component of a multimodal system, built and integrated for reliable cross-modal understanding.

card.p: Building pipelines to ingest and align text, images, and audio from various sources, ensuring proper tokenization and preprocessing for each modality.
Selecting and configuring the right multimodal architecture (e.g., CLIP, Flamingo, LLaVA) for your use case, balancing performance and computational cost.
Designing the fusion mechanism (early, late, or hybrid) to combine embeddings from different modalities, optimizing for cross-modal interaction.
Training or fine-tuning the multimodal model on your domain-specific data, with careful handling of modality imbalance and alignment.
Testing the model's performance on cross-modal tasks using relevant benchmarks and custom metrics, ensuring robust understanding and generation.
Deploying the multimodal model as a scalable API, integrated with your product or workflows, with monitoring for drift and accuracy.
